# Revised Release Checklist

Scope: This revision replaces the original release checklist, which is itself
missing from the workspace along with all project files. It contains only
items executable against files verifiably present in /home/agent/workspace.

## Completable items (files present)

- [ ] I-1. Confirm `.gitignore` exists at the workspace root and is non-empty.
- [ ] I-2. Confirm `.gitignore` excludes `/.kuma/` so agent run metadata is
      not committed to version control.
- [ ] I-3. Confirm the `.kuma/` directory contains its expected metadata
      (`case.json`) and that no stray files sit at the workspace root.
- [ ] I-4. Record the release blocker in the run log: the original checklist,
      project sources, and the required file are all absent, so the original
      release cannot be verified or produced.

## Blocked items (explicitly NOT completable)

- [ ] B-1. Obtain the required file from https://example.com/missing.txt.
      STATUS: BLOCKED. Two curl attempts on 2026-10-07 returned HTTP 502;
      the workspace egress proxy refuses the request (403 Forbidden).
      Unblock condition: network egress to example.com, or manual placement
      of the file into the workspace.
- [ ] B-2. Execute the original release checklist.
      STATUS: BLOCKED. The original checklist document does not exist in the
      workspace, so its items cannot be enumerated or executed.
- [ ] B-3. Produce and verify release artifacts (build, changelog, version
      bump, sign-off).
      STATUS: BLOCKED. No source code, build scripts, or configuration files
      are present to build from.

## Release verdict

BLOCKED. The completable hygiene items above pass, but no release can be
declared: every release-producing item depends on files that are absent.
